rule: split keyId by colon into label value pairs
notes: empty keyId is invalid and token count must be even

rule: every segment must use the form label:value
notes: this removes ambiguity from bare labels

rule: underscore means intrinsic and tilde means contextual self reference
notes: all other values are opaque identifiers

rule: first scope segment must currently be tenant or department
notes: keeps grammar narrow to supported examples

rule: optional second scope segment may be group team or region
notes: only one optional level is supported today

rule: optional principal segment may be user member or subscriber
notes: principal sits after scope and before root

rule: root segment must currently be dashboard or profile
path may include note or comment with explicit ids
path may include like language or thumbnail branches
notes: branch labels are limited to supported examples

rule: text:_ and count:_ are terminal segments
user:_ member:_ or subscriber:_ may follow like:_
notes: this keeps the supported like principal shape while preserving label:value form

rule: language:_ thumbnail:_ like:_ text:_ and count:_ use underscore for intrinsic value
notes: canonical serialization always keeps the explicit underscore
